_comment: run_22 = run_21 (single habitat field, occupied-habitat centring, K level 3.0 +/- 1.0) with RELATIVE mate-finding: allee_factor = 1 - exp(-gamma * N/K), n50 a FRACTION of local capacity.

Why: in every refined variant (run_19..21) cells with lambda_fund > 1 but K below the absolute Allee threshold ('Allee-dead', 20-40% of suitable habitat) were how capacity carved out absence; with N/K, viability depends only on lambda and the one global gamma, never on K, so absence has to come from growth. Not the prior belief (mates are found by absolute density); tested for fit and for the biological implausibilities run_21 showed (fecundity ~10 and flat, juvenile survival 0.93 > adult 0.42).

n50 prior: median 5% of K (n50_raw_loc = softplus^-1(0.05) = -2.97), scale 1.0 -- at the typical capacity of ~2.6 route counts that is ~0.13 counts, the absolute form's current prior median, so the two agree where most birds live.
